item.title: If the OoT Remake team could only make either a Majora's Mask Remake or a new game, what would you prefer?
item.author: invalid@example.com (Jetsun Mila)
item.dc:creator: Jetsun Mila
item.content:encoded: What the title says. The team can only do one game and you have to choose. Personally I would prefer a new game. As much as I like what they did with OoT it just didn't change enough for me, which is the main reason I don't buy it, and Majora's Mask will likely be the same. But with how it looks like they nailed the gameplay feel and with how they got to work out what made classic Zelda work I'd love to see them do their own take on classic Zelda.

item.title: Hot take: I like classical videogame biomes
item.author: invalid@example.com (xyla)
item.dc:creator: xyla
item.content:encoded: I got thinking about Mario Sunshine and how it's a real step to the side from the usual snow, desert, grass, lava biomes/worlds that are usually part of Mario games. That's all, maybe not that hot of a take after all.
